dedupe_keys.name: alberta s manufacturing industries naics 1 3 4 5 and 6 digits by alberta s census divisions 2009

description: These Alberta customisations of the Annual Survey of Manufactures and Logging describe manufacturing establishments, production, inventories and operating costs. Original 2007–2009 tables report census-division and NAICS breakdowns including energy, water-utility and vehicle-fuel costs. Four companion members add Canada/Alberta commodity-sector estimates for 2007–2008 and 2008–2009, Alberta concentration ratios for 2008, and products produced and shipped for 2012. Their descriptions explicitly identify the same underlying survey. This is one bounded, curator-grouped collection of related statistical tables; it does not claim that the publisher distributes a single combined workbook. XLS and XLSX representations remain individually identified. Dimensions, geographic coverages and years differ, so tables are not treated as substitutes or a continuous time series. Metadata identifies demand forecasting among uses of the survey. The catalogue labels the information Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, current file access, units and detailed numerical comparability are unverified. No workbook or other data body was fetched.
